% Pattern: number/title. An unnumbered environment whose title ends in a letter
% prints the letter as its number. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thma-1 statement/theorem A
% want corc-1 statement/corollary C
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem*{thmA}{Theorem A}
\newtheorem*{corC}{Corollary C}
\begin{document}
\begin{thmA} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thmA}
\begin{corC} Every finite space is bounded. \end{corC}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
